title: thelypteris retroflexa
intro: Thelypteris retroflexa, commonly known as the flexile fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris retroflexa include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, making it a valuable resource for managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant are primarily flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
